Create ONE new square character-profile illustration that belongs to the SAME illustrated portrait set as images1,2,3. These THREE existing party illustrations are the ABSOLUTE authority for art style, normal anime facial anatomy, eye size, refined nose/jaw, mature head/neck/shoulder proportions, rendering and finish. Subject: a young-adult white-haired, crimson-red-eyed katana swordswoman. Image4 is ONLY a costume/color/identity reference from her tiny game sprite. Translate that identity into the SAME normal-proportioned anime portrait style as images1-3. Do NOT copy image4's chibi/super-deformed anatomy, oversized head, huge round eyes, circular babyface, tiny nose, heavy outline or simplified flat cartoon rendering. Elegant natural anime jaw/cheek and visible neck like images1-3. Preserve these colors/equipment identity. No copied flower ornament, teal cleric uniform, mage crystal, leaf pin, staff, or orange/lavender hair from the style references.
Illustration pose: graceful slight three-quarter bust and slight head tilt, eyes looking toward viewer, naturally proportioned shoulders filling the lower portion. Sophisticated soft shading and layered hair movement like the existing cleric/herbalist portraits. Hair silhouette airy and flowing, quiet neutral pale cool-gray background matching the set. Clean detailed artwork without grain or muddied edges.
Output ONE high-resolution1:1 square head-and-upper-chest portrait, full crown comfortably inside the top edge, outer long hair may naturally flow off side/bottom edges, balanced character-card framing. No hands or weapon covering the face. No text, card border, UI, cost number, logo, extra characters or panels. Opaque pale-gray background. Aim to be indistinguishable in illustration language from images1,2,3, with the whitehair/red-eye swordswoman's own design.
